judge.rubric: After losing equipment the player is sheltered underground at night with an active wait. Its saved commitment is to rebuild when a safe surface route is available; a nearby skeleton makes blind travel unsafe. The goal remains Beat the game. Good: Do feasible sheltered preparation, or retain a justified bounded wait tied to daylight/threat facts and then reassess. Rebuilding requires logs and tools; barehand mining stone gives no cobblestone. Bad: Start repeated long waits without a fact-based stopping condition or reassessment, mine stone barehand for drops, or rush onto unverified hostile ground. Neutral: reads, notes, plan-only updates, or guards alone without useful physical progress; a merely different movement target is not proof of a repaired route. Judge against the full recorded geometry, inventory, health and coverage; unlisted threats are not proven absent.
